observations: The page number «186» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it; at the left the number of the table, «Tab. 72», in bold sans serif, underlined. The page has no signature. The titles (L01-L02), in bold, the sigla in roman: «Tabula coniunctionis et oppositionis in mensibus1) (CN)» and O's «Pagina mensium coniunctionis et oppositionis (O)»; a thin stroke like an acute stands over the o of «coniunctionis» in L01 and a curved mark like a breve over the u of «mensium» in L02, not transcribed. The folios of the manuscripts stand at the left of the titles in two lines, «C 82v, O 139v,» and «N 44r.», the letters raised; here as left margin notes.

The table: eighteen columns divided by double vertical rules: «Notulae2)» and «Dies3) subtrahendi», printed upwards, «Menses arabum», «Horae» over «Horae», «Min.», «Sec.», and «Medium4) solis et lunae», «Argumentum lunae» and «Argumentum latitudinis», each over «Sig.», «Gr.», «Min.», «Sec.»; the units in smaller bold type. Here each head is set from the top, one printed line to a line (L03-L05); the cells separated by our «|»; a head followed by empty cells spans their columns. The rows (L06-L17) are the twelve months, with notes 5-15 at their names; the values of a row belong to the months elapsed before the month named, zero at Elmuharram.

L06-L17. Checked: the time is k synodic months of 29d 12h 44m 3s, the time of the row of Zafar with its day subtracted, less the days of the k months elapsed, 30 and 29 in turn (30, 59, 89, … 325); where the days exceed the synodic months, after an odd number of months, a day is subtracted and 24 hours added («Dies subtrahendi» 1 at Zafar, Rabe elakhir, Jum. elakhir, Scabin, Scauel and Dulheia). The times agree to the second in every row except at Scauel (L15): see the critical note.

L06-L17, continued. The mean longitude is the motion of the sun in the k synodic months, k · 29° 6′ 19.4″, the month values of Tab. 4 (p. 115, JP2 0147) less the day subtracted plus the motion in the hours: within 2″ in seven rows; at Rabe elawel 1s 28° 12′ 29″ for 1s 28° 12′ 39″, at Jumedi elakhir 4s 25° 31′ 56″ for 4s 25° 31′ 37″, at Scabin 6s 23° 44′ 54″ for 6s 23° 44′ 16″, at Ramadh 7s 22° 50′ 54″ for 7s 22° 50′ 36″, and at Dulkada 9s 21° 3′ 53″, the 53 of C and O, for 9s 21° 3′ 15″, where N has 13 (note e); no note bears on the other four. The anomaly is k · 25° 49′ 0.6″ within 3″, its seconds running 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and then 7 to Dulheia where the law gives 1, 1, 2, 3, 3, 4, 4, 5, 6, 6, 7; the argument of latitude is k · 1s 0° 40′ 14″ within 1″ in every row. Twelve synodic months give 11s 19° 15′ 53″, 10s 9° 48′ 8″ and 0s 8° 2′ 48″, within 2″ of the 11s 19° 15′ 55″, 10s 9° 48′ 10″ and 0s 8° 2′ 50″ of the year 1 in Tab. 71 (p. 185, JP2 0217).

L06-L17, «Notulae». The weekday numbers of the months, 0 at Elmuharram, agree with the notae of the months in Tab. 2 (p. 110, JP2 0142) less 1, the days elapsed counted in weeks, at Zafar (2), Rabe elawel (3), Jumedi elakhir (1), Regeb (2), Scabin (4) and Scauel (7, for 0); at Rabe elakhir, Jumedi elule, Ramadh, Dulkada and Dulheia the printed 3, 4, 4, 7 and 2 differ from the 5, 6, 5, 1 and 3 so obtained; at Jumedi elule N has 3 (note a), at Dulkada C has 6 (note b). The edition prints the column as the manuscripts give it.

Notes on the readings. Checked: the edition's readings are those of the computation at Jumedi elule and Dulheia in the degrees of the mean longitude (notes c and d: the 26 of C and O against N's 36; 20 against the 9 of C and O and N's 19; 3s 26° 25′ 18″ and 10s 20° 9′ 34″ computed) and at Ramadh in the minutes of the anomaly (note f: 32 against the 42 of C and O; 6s 26° 32′ 5″ computed). At Dulkada (note e) N's 13 is the nearer to the computation, 9s 21° 3′ 15″.

Notes 1-15: the names of the months in the manuscripts: «Szafar» (N), Ṣafar; «elawel», «I» (O), al-awwal; «elakir» (C), «II» (O), al-ākhir; O's «Gum̆. primus» and «Gum̆. II», the m with a breve, for Jumādā l-ūlā and Jumādā l-ākhira, the table's «Jum. elakhir» and the lemma «Jumedi elakhir»; «Rageb» (N), Rajab; «Shabin» (C) and «Shaaben» (N), Shaʿbān; the lemma «Ramadh.» with the point, the table «Ramadh», C's «Ramthan» and O's «Ră(..)ă», the breves and the dots in parentheses as printed, Ramaḍān; «Shawel» (C) and «Sewil» (N), Shawwāl; «Dulkesa» (O) and «Dulkadda» (N), Dhū l-qaʿda; «Dulhegga» (N), Dhū l-ḥijja. «elwacat» (C), al-wasaṭ, the mean. Italics: «om.».

critical_notes.evidence: the minutes of the time at Scauel: 9 synodic months of 29d 12h 44m 3s are 265d 18h 36m 27s, a day less than the 266 days of the nine months elapsed and 18h 36m 27s; the times of the other rows agree to the second; a 7 is printed for the 6
